recipe.visualDefinition: A joyful group portrait of four performers in 1970s attire, captured in a dynamic, dancing pose against a soft, draped pink fabric background. The lighting is diffused, creating a hazy, nostalgic atmosphere typical of late 70s soul and disco aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction through overlapping limbs and shared joyful expressions
Contrast between the dark formal jackets and the light pastel backdrop
Rhythmic placement of figures creating a sense of movement from left to right
Integration of fluid script typography with the upper negative space

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four full-body figures arranged horizontally across the frame, occupying the central and lower two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a white blazer, acting as a bridge between the dark-clad figure on the left and the female figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the diagonal line of the script at the top, then drop to the expressive faces and follow the rhythmic 'V' shapes of the dancing legs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant breathing room at the top for typography; minimal space at the bottom near the feet.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and black (jackets and trousers)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream and light blue (shirts and blazers)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-contrast, high-key palette with soft shadows and a slightly desaturated, vintage film quality.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to pastels and deep neutrals

letterConstructionRules: High slant angle to the right
Varying line weight mimicking a felt-tip marker or brush
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature expressive, looping swashes
Lowercase 't' bars are long and integrated into the word flow

composition.relationshipToImage: floats in the upper negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for all text elements to maintain a personal, 'signed' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, marker-like quality of the original lettering.
Captures the personal, artist-branded feel of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a four-person music group (three men, one woman) in 1970s disco fashion, dancing and laughing against a draped pink fabric backdrop. Use soft-focus lighting and a vintage film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of dark blue-purple handwritten cursive script across the top, following a slight natural arch.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft and diffused?
Does the clothing reflect late 70s styles (wide lapels, flares)?
Is the typography fluid and slanted?
Is the background a textured pink fabric?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original artists

mustAchieve: Sense of genuine joy and motion

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern technology is visible in the background
Check that the script does not obscure the faces
Verify the soft-focus effect is consistent across the frame
Confirm the clothing silhouettes are period-accurate
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio group portrait + [Subject Description] + 1970s disco fashion + soft-focus pink backdrop + [Color] handwritten script overlay.
